The '''''Harvest Moon''''' was a 100-ton [[Grain/Legends|grain]] [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] operating during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Working in the [[Sarrahban system/Legends|Sarrahban system]], it was used to [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggle]] [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] refugees and [[ytterbium]] out of the [[Star system/Legends|system]].

==Description==
The ''Harvest Moon'' was a 100-[[Metric ton/Legends|ton]] grain [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]]. It was equipped with both [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight]] and [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperspace]] [[Engine/Legends|engines]].<ref name="TRG1-115" />

==History==
The ''Harvest Moon'' was part of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Rebel cell (Sarrahban)|partisan force]] operating on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sarrahban]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Although Sarrabhan attempted to remain neutral in the conflict, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] deployed a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] to bring the planet under Imperial rule. Forewarned of the [[Invasion of Sarrahban|invasion]], the Alliance forces on the planet prepared to evacuate aboard the ''Harvest Moon'', escorted by armed [[T-16 skyhopper/Legends|T-16 skyhoppers]]. The freighter was carrying Alliance refugees and Sarrabhan's reserves of stabilized [[ytterbium]].<ref name="TRG1-115" />

As the ''Harvest Moon'' and its escort launched from the surface, they were attacked by a wing of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]]. Although the T-16s managed to destroy and drive off the enemy, the ''Harvest Moon'' had taken a direct hit to the planetary drive engines. The freighter subsequently crashed in the planet's equatorial highlands. The T-16s managed to right the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] after its landing, but parts to fix the freighter were required. The closest source of the parts were located across the [[Water/Legends|ocean]], and a team of operatives took the T-16s to recover the parts while the refugees in the treated the wounded.<ref name="TRG1-115" />

Due to the Imperial forces dealing with Sarrabahn's planetary defenses, locating the downed ''Harvest Moon'' had not been a priority. Refugees began seeing Imperial search parties shortly before the operatives who went for the spare parts returned. As repairs were being made, an Imperial [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] located the crash site. After informing Imperial headquarters, the cruiser deployed a [[Platoon/Legends|platoon]] of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]]. Alliance forces held off the mercenaries long enough for the repairs to be completed, then the ''Harvest Moon'' lifted off, running the gauntlet of Imperial ships and escaping into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].<ref name="TRG1-115" />
